obligations.text: The size of the random sample, set out in column B, shall depend on the size of the financial institution's small business lending application register, as shown in column A of table 1 to appendix F.

The safe harbor in § 1002.112(c)(3) applies to an incorrect entry for the 3-digit NAICS code that financial institutions must collect and report pursuant to § 1002.107(a)(15), provided certain conditions are met.
